Actual Article Body:
Scotland drew 0-0 with Slovenia in Pocognoli’s dugout bow as national team boss last month.

And he has made two changes to his starting XI from the victory in Skoje on Saturday.

Jack Hendry and Ryan Christie come into the line-up as Scott McKenna is suspended as Kieron Bowie drops out.

Ahead of the clash against Slovenia, Pocognoli said: “You look at the positive or you look at the negative and you look also at what we needed to improve before I arrived and we create more chances.

“So that’s positive with a new group of players with a totally new principle and that’s quite good if it’s like this for games.

“But in football sometimes you have luck and sometimes not, but we definitely should score in the second half in Slovenia and we would have a different ranking today.

“But it’s like life, with the ‘if’ you never know where you go, but the reality is we have to win tomorrow and try to score goals.

Read more:

“But Kieron scores goals at his club, Oli (McBurnie) scores goals with Hull City, Robbie (Ure) scored goals last season, this season is more challenging because he needs to adapt to a different level, it is the same at the national team.

“You have adaptation, you sometimes have luck on the day and sometimes, yeah, it’s just to have the quality.

“But we create chances and we have good strikers and we have good midfielders and we have also wingers who create a lot of chances, with Robbo (Andy Robertson) and (Aaron Hickey) also.

“So it’s also to create a danger from many positions as possible.”

SCOTLAND XI: Gunn, Welsh, Hendry, Binks, Gannon-Doak, Gilmour, Ferguson, Robertson, McGinn, Christie, McBurnie

SUBS: Kelly, Bain, Hickey, Doig, Ure, Miller, McPake, Curtis, Graham, Bowie, Patterson, Montgomery
